data.segment_title: Preview/Introduction Dan Rather (Republican National Convention in New York)

data.segment_description:
(New York: Dan Rather) Day 2 of the Republican National Convention in New York City, where California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger and First Lady Laura Bush will speak, introduced. 
 (Convention floor: John Roberts) The direction for the convention tonight previewed; details given of President Bush’s correction of his recent statement that the war on terror is not winnable and of Republican efforts to appeal to moderate voters; excerpt from Laura Bush’s speech quoted. [In Nashville, BUSH – states we are winning and we will win.] [Last night, Senator John McCAIN – praises Bush.] [Last night, former New York City Mayor Rudolph GIULIANI – criticizes Senator John Kerry’s inconsistencies on terrorism.] [Bush daughter Jenna BUSH – introduces her mother.] [SCHWARZENEGGER – calls New York City firefighters “true action heroes.”] [“The Hotline” editor Chuck TODD†- comments on voter perception of the Republicans’ shift to the middle.] 
 (New York: Dan Rather) Report introduced. 
 (New York: Jim Axelrod) The Democrats’ response to the attacks on Kerry featured; scenes shown of the Democrats’ “war room,” where staffers discuss how to undermine the Republicans; details given about the value of the Republicans’ star speakers {McCain, Giuliani & Schwarzenegger}. [University of Virginia Larry SABATO†- notes the convention’s message that Bush can defend against terrorism and Kerry can’t.] [Iowa Governor Tom VILSACK – says the mission hasn’t been accomplished.] [Last night, GIULIANI – says they will continue to hear from us.]

(New York: Dan Rather) The strength of Hurricane Frances noted; map shown of projected path. 
 (Richmond, Virginia: Sharyl Attkisson) The impact of rains brought by Tropical Storm Gaston on Virginia featured; scenes shown of flood damage, including cars upturned and smashed into buildings and muddy streets, in Richmond; [Richmond City Manager Calvin JAMISON††- points out damage.]

(New York: Dan Rather) The massacre of 12 kidnapped workers from Nepal & the status of 2 French journalists held hostage in Iraq, and a suicide bombing, possibly carried out by a woman from Chechnya, at a subway station in Moscow, Russia, reported; scenes & videos shown.   (Beersheba, Israel: David Hawkins) A double suicide bombing involving two buses in Beersheba††, Israel, featured; scenes shown of the wrecked buses, injured people & the Israeli army’s raid on the homes of the bombers; details given of Hamas’ claim that the bombings were retaliation for Israel’s murder of 2 of their leaders; video shown of the bombers. [Rescue worker Yossi LANDAU†- comments on the end of a break in the violence.]

data.segment_title: Inside Story (The Bush Promise: Political Unity) Part II
data.segment_description:
(New York: Dan Rather) Special convention-week look at what has become of the promises made by President Bush during his 2000 presidential campaign continued. 
 (Alleman, Iowa: Bill Whitaker) Bush’s promise to end political rivalry in Washington, DC, examined. [At the Republican National Convention in August, 2000, BUSH – says he wants to change the tone in Washington to one of civility & respect.] [Last April, Senator Robert BYRD†- says this president has sown divisions in our long-standing alliances.] [Brookings Institution Thomas MANN†- says the president has been a divider, not a unifier.] [Last February, Senator Edward KENNEDY – criticizes Bush’s cut in funding for No Child Left Behind.] [Senior presidential advisor Karl ROVE†- comments on politics becoming more competitive.] [At the Republican National Convention last night, former New York City Mayor Rudolph GIULIANI – calls for uniting to end the threat of global terrorism.]
